# Quotient topology generated by finite suprema of seminorms

Let `𝕜` be a normed field
and `X` a topological `𝕜`-module with an additive commutative group. Suppose its topology
is generated by seminorms `p_i` indexed by a nonempty type `ι`. For every submodule `Y`,
the quotient topology on `X/Y` is generated by `(sup_{i∈s} p_i).quotient Y` for finite
subsets `s⊆ι`. The quotient seminorm is the infimum over coset representatives. No
closedness of `Y` is assumed.
